messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "do not stop on your own if pregnant"
set: ["do not stop on your own if pregnant", "do not stop treatment on your own", "do not stop taking on your own even if you feel fine", "do not stop taking on your own without speaking to doctor first", "do not stop suddenly", "do not stop abruptly", "do not stop taking suddenly", "do not stop using suddenly", "stop using and tell doctor if pregnant", "do not stop without speaking to your doctor first", "do not stop taking without talking to your doctor", "do not stop using without first asking your doctor", "tell your doctor if your symptoms do not improve", "stop taking and tell doctor immediately if pregnant", "stop using and tell doctor immediately if pregnant", "do not stop using escitalopram suddenly"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "do not stop treatment on your own",
    "do not stop taking on your own even if you feel fine",
    "do not stop taking on your own without speaking to doctor first",
    "do not stop suddenly",
    "do not stop abruptly",
    "do not stop taking suddenly",
    "do not stop using suddenly",
    "do not stop without speaking to your doctor first",
    "do not stop taking without talking to your doctor",
    "do not stop using without first asking your doctor"
  ],
  "alias": "do not stop on your own if pregnant"
}
